inputs.share_count_basis: 568.54m issued shares excluding 16.56m treasury shares per HKEX monthly return for September 2026 (filed 2026-10-05), plus ~0.5m treasury-stock-method dilution from 8.42m outstanding options (FY2025 diluted adjustment was 0.46m; most options are out of the money). Shares held by the share-award trustee are kept in the count. The count is held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The 2026 buybacks that took treasury from 1.77m to 16.56m are already in the lower count, and their estimated cash cost is deducted in equity_bridge so the count and the cash are on the same date.
inputs.cash_composition: 31-Dec-2025: cash and cash equivalents 611.254 + non-current time deposit 52.086 + current FVPL financial assets (bank wealth-management products, redeemed and re-bought each year: 1,746m purchased / 1,718m redeemed in FY2025) 406.779 = 1,070.119 RMB m. No bank borrowings (gearing note: total interest-bearing borrowings nil). Lease liabilities of 15.94 are excluded from debt under lease treatment (B).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report cash-flow reconciliation, equity-settled share-based payments of RMB18,698k (line 11178). Equity-award withholding taxes are nil, so no combined figure is needed.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025: RMB29.74m in total for share-award-scheme and treasury purchases (3.218m shares). FY2024: RMB112.4m. 2026 YTD: treasury shares went from 1.772m to 16.556m, an estimated ~RMB115m at about HK$9.1 per share. The company actively repurchases, so the flat count is being funded.
inputs.fx_note: Model currency CNY, quote currency HKD. 1 CNY = 1.1724 HKD (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16 close). Cross-rate check: USD/HKD 7.8479 / USD/CNY 6.6768 = 1.1754 (0.3% tie). There is no A-share or ADR dual listing to parity-check against. The FY2025 annual report converted at about 1.08 (HK$19.90m = RMB18.43m), so the RMB has appreciated about 8% against the HKD since 2025. refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-08-31T08:08:46Z last regular-session trade before SUSPENSION. Trading has been suspended since 2026-09-01 09:00 HKT (HKEX exchange notice). Yahoo serves this frozen quote with zero volume through 2026-10-16. It is not a live price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta 1.1 x CNY equity risk premium 6.5% = ~9.0% cost of equity, + 0.5pp for size and liquidity (HK$4.6bn market cap, mid-cap HK-listed medtech) = 9.5%. Ungeared (no borrowings), so WACC = CoE. The same 9.5% is used in every scenario. Governance risk from the 2026 suspension is charged ONCE, through the bear path and its 30% weight, and not as a premium in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. The full lease cash payment (FY2025: capital 25.101 + interest 1.179 = 26.28 RMB m, 3.3% of revenue) is charged via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (15.94) are excluded from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 58.492 - 24.325 = 34.167, 4.3% of revenue), so cash-tax EBIT is not charged the lease twice. The path is lifted to 3.5% because the disputed new lease (rent, security deposit, renovation costs) is the subject of the 2026 investigation.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is a small deficit (-4.487 RMB m equity; -0.759 m share of FY2025 loss). Its losses stay inside the consolidated flows and nothing is deducted in the bridge. Immaterial.
inputs.ebitda_basis: Adjusted EBITDA is before SBC and lease cost and excludes treasury income. FY2025: profit from operations 317.496 - interest income 15.603 + FVPL fair-value loss 5.178 - FX gain 1.113 = 305.958 operating, + D&A 58.492 = 364.45 post-SBC EBITDA (incl. ROU depreciation added back), + SBC 18.698 = 383.15 = 48.5% of revenue. Government R&D and overseas grants (35.9 m, 4.5% of revenue) are kept in EBITDA but fade in every path. Share of associate losses (25.3) and the associate impairment (59.6) are below operating profit and excluded. The associate is instead carried at book in equity_bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, the component route with non-US adaptations (CNY flows, HKD quote, IFRS 16 leases, SBC-light HK filer). Routing: a profitable operating medtech, the neurovascular device maker (Tubridge flow diverters, NUMEN coils, thrombectomy/aspiration catheters). It has had positive reported FCF every year FY2021-FY2025 and net cash of ~RMB1.07bn, so it is not a growth-stage cash burner, and owner-FCF is the right model. There is no MEMORY.md entry because this is the first valuation. MATERIAL EVENT: trading has been suspended since 2026-09-01. The board delayed the H1-2026 interim results to investigate (a) the background of a lessor and its relationship with a company shareholder, (b) the reasonableness of the lease rent and security-deposit terms, and (c) additional renovation costs on the leased areas and their accounting (inside-information announcement dated 2026-08-31). This is a related-party / governance question, not a solvency one: the company has no debt and ~RMB1bn of liquid assets, and it continued publishing operational announcements (NMPA green-path designation for the NUWISMEN liquid embolic agent, 2026-09-24). The going-concern three-scenario frame is kept, with the bear weight raised. current_price is the frozen pre-suspension last trade. FY2025 owner-FCF of 120.1 is depressed by a ~185m jump in trade receivables (1-3 month bucket from 10.2m to 113.6m, linked to the VBP tender roll-out). The component build normalises this through wc_capture rather than carrying the FY2025 margin forward. Buybacks are funded (repurchaser), so the flat count is not just a modelling convention.

equity_bridge.item: Investment in associates at book (post FY2025 impairment)
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR balance sheet. Its share of losses is excluded from the flows, so the asset goes in at book. The FY2025 59.6m impairment shows book is not conservative, but the amount is small.

equity_bridge.item: 2026 YTD treasury-share repurchases (estimated cash, post balance sheet)
equity_bridge.note: Treasury shares rose from 1.772m (31-Dec-2025, AR line 1877) to 16.556m (Sep-2026 monthly return), about 14.8m shares at ~HK$9.1 = HK$135m / 1.17 = ~RMB115m. The deduction matches the share count, which already excludes these shares.

equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend HK$0.09/share paid 2026 (cash portion, estimated)
equity_bridge.note: Final dividend notice 2026-07-22: HK$0.09 per share with a scrip alternative. 570m x 0.09 = HK$51m, ~RMB44m, less an assumed ~10% scrip take-up. It was not accrued at 31-Dec-2025.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: The 6.9% equity 3-year CAGR is about 47% below the 13.0% revenue 3-year CAGR. Equity growth is suppressed by dividends (RMB90m FY24, RMB84m FY25) and buybacks (RMB112m FY24) on a net-cash balance sheet, so it understates operating growth. The FY2021 equity base is negative (pre-IPO preferred-share liabilities of RMB1.24bn), so no 5-year equity or EPS CAGR exists. FY2022 EPS was negative, so EPS uses FY2023-FY2025.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income on amortised-cost assets, applied to the whole history. The owner-FCF 3-year CAGR (-7.9%) is below the reported one (-4.3%) because SBC tripled in FY2025 (6.2 to 18.7) while FCF fell. The FCF series is lumpy because of working capital: FY2023 and FY2025 were receivable-build years and FY2024 a release year. Revenue growth decelerated sharply, from +43% FY22 to +22%, +14% and +3.8% FY25, under VBP price cuts. H1 FY2025 revenue fell 6% YoY before H2 recovered +15%.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 at 6% because the FY2025 run-rate was +3.8% (H1 -6%, H2 +15%) and VBP repricing is still rolling through provinces. Growth recovers to 8-9% as VBP volume gains offset price cuts and overseas sales (13% of revenue, +39% in FY2025) compound. It then decays to 3% by Y10.
base.margin_rationale: Starts 1pp below FY2025's 48.5% adjusted EBITDA margin and erodes 0.5pp/yr to 44% as VBP prices reset, overseas mix (distributor margins) rises and government grants (4.5% of revenue) fade. Gross margin was 73.5% in FY2025.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer with receivables + inventory - payables of about 35% of FY2025 revenue (362 + 119 - 205 = 276). Growth consumes cash at that rate on the revenue increment.

bear.tax_rationale: The bear case assumes the High and New Technology Enterprise 15% preference is lost or diluted (it is contingent on R&D intensity and governance standing) and the rate ramps to the 25% PRC statutory rate.

scenario_narratives.base: VBP is a volume-for-price trade that roughly nets out. Provincial and inter-provincial alliance tenders (Hebei-led alliance, Henan, Anhui, Guangdong) cut unit prices on flow diverters, intracranial stents and coils, but the group's core products win the bids and gain hospital penetration. Overseas (36 countries, 13% of revenue, +39%) compounds. Growth recovers from FY2025's +3.8% to high single digits and fades to 3%. Adjusted EBITDA margin erodes from 48.5% to 44% as price resets and grants fade. The lease investigation ends in a modest restatement or rent renegotiation, and trading resumes without lasting damage to the franchise.
scenario_narratives.bull: Next-generation launches lead domestic share gains as the market shifts from imported to domestic devices under VBP: Tubridge flow diverters, the Artemis Dream drug-eluting intracranial stent and the NUWISMEN liquid embolic (both on the NMPA innovative green path in 2026), and WAVE-track aspiration. Overseas becomes a second growth engine. Revenue compounds in the low teens for five years and margin holds near 47-48% on mix and operating leverage. The related-party lease is found to be on arm's-length terms and resumption is quick.
scenario_narratives.bear: The investigation finds value leaking to a shareholder-linked lessor through above-market rent, an outsized security deposit and capitalised renovation costs. That forces a restatement, board changes and a prolonged suspension. Under the HKEX rule a suspension longer than 18 months can lead to delisting, which would trap minority holders. On the business side, further VBP rounds cut prices faster than volume grows: FY2026 revenue falls (as H1 FY2025 did, -6%), margin compresses toward 36%, the HNTE tax preference is lost, and the receivable build that depressed FY2025 OCF proves to be channel stuffing ahead of tenders.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear is raised from the 15% house default to 30% because trading is suspended pending an internal investigation of a shareholder-linked lease. That is an unresolved governance event with restatement and prolonged-suspension risk, plus a VBP single-regulator pricing dependency. Base stays at 50%: the business has no debt, ~RMB1bn of liquid assets and a market-leading domestic franchise. Bull is cut to 20% because it needs both a clean investigation outcome and a reacceleration to double-digit growth after a +3.8% year.

valuation_philosophy.summary: This is a net-cash, profitable Chinese neurovascular device franchise valued on owner FCF in CNY and converted to HKD. About a quarter of the market cap is liquid assets. The valuation turns on (1) whether VBP price resets are offset by volume and overseas growth, and (2) the outcome of the 2026 related-party lease investigation that suspended trading. The quoted price is a frozen pre-suspension trade, so any upside is not realisable until trading resumes.
key_risks_to_valuation: Trading suspended since 2026-09-01 pending an investigation into a shareholder-linked lease; possible restatement, governance changes, and the HKEX 18-month delisting rule if not remedied
Further VBP rounds on neurovascular consumables cutting prices faster than volumes grow (H1 FY2025 revenue -6%)
Trade receivables doubled in FY2025 (RMB144m to RMB321m); if the build is not collected, FY2025 earnings quality is weaker than reported
HNTE 15% tax preference contingent; loss lifts cash tax toward 25%
Government grants (4.5% of revenue) are discretionary and fade
FX: CNY flows against an HKD quote; the RMB is up ~8% vs HKD since 2025, which flatters the HKD value
